title: Thermodynamic Limits of Proof
summary: Every irreversible recorded distinction has a positive thermodynamic work floor. Landauer's principle supplies the ideal bound $\varepsilon\ge k_B T\ln 2$ per irreversible bit, experimentally verified to $\pm 10\%$. Proof available to an agent is checkable information for that agent: some substrate must produce, retain, and expose evidence that excludes answer-changing alternatives. A finite detector array operating at temperature $T$ for finite time has finite signal-acquisition capacity.
